_about: Sentences a client or judge might say on a call, and what the phone should do with each. kind: small_talk (nothing), instruction (noted, confirm in writing), request (to do), question (card, or follow-up), info (noted), other (nothing). Add real sentences from the judge conversations here (see data/sessions/, python -m backend.utterance review) and run python -m pytest tests/test_utterance.py.
